offering_description.value: Owns and operates very large gas carriers that transport liquefied petroleum gas by sea. Charters ships to energy producers, traders and petrochemical companies worldwide, earning time charter hire and voyage freight.

primary_services.value: seaborne LPG transportation; vessel chartering; ship management

customer_segment.value: B2B: LPG producers, commodity traders, petrochemical companies, national oil companies

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: time charter hire paid for use of vessels with crew; transaction or usage fees: voyage freight paid per cargo carried
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs a fleet of gas carriers, sells vessel capacity to cargo owners; service provider: moves LPG cargoes for producers and traders under charter contracts

geography_served.value: global: worldwide routes linking Middle East, US, Asia and Europe

specialization.value: niche specialist: very large gas carrier shipping only, no other lines

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: time charters negotiated directly with large cargo owners; agents / brokers: shipbrokers arranging voyage charters for spot cargoes

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: maritime emissions, safety and pollution rules such as IMO MARPOL and flag-state regulations

notes: Fleet size and ownership mix change over time, so current vessel counts may differ.
